question: Which of the following organisations developed the nanoporous multilayered polymeric membrane for high-pressure seawater desalination in May 2025?

options.text: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO):** DRDO is a prominent organization under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, responsible for developing advanced technologies for defence and security purposes.
 
• In **May 2025**, DRDO developed the **nanoporous multilayered polymeric membrane** for high-pressure seawater desalination, addressing the critical need for clean and potable water.
 
• The innovation is aimed at improving the efficiency of seawater desalination processes, enabling the extraction of water even under high-pressure conditions.
